subject: Biology
source_note: TIE (2023), Biology Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the concepts, principles and processes of Biology

sub_topics.title: Describe the physiological, anatomical and ecological processes of living organisms
competences: (a) Describe reproduction in plants (concept of reproduction in plants, asexual and sexual reproduction, pollination and fertilization)
(b) Describe reproduction in humans (sexual reproduction in human, fertilization, pregnancy and child birth)
(c) Describe the mechanisms of growth in mammals and flowering plants (concept of growth, mitosis and growth, growth and developmental stages in human and seed germination)
(d) Explore the basic tenets of genetics (genetic materials, principles of inhertance, monohybrid, Mendelian and non-Mendelian inheritance; variation

objectives.text: (a) Describe reproduction in plants (concept of reproduction in plants, asexual and sexual reproduction, pollination and fertilization)
objectives.resources: Reproduction in plants online resources, potted plants, hibiscus flowers, bean flowers, elephant grass flowers, hand lens, surgical/ razor blade, pictures/ illustration showing reproduction in plants
objectives.assessment_criteria: Reproduction in plants is described clearly

objectives.text: (b) Describe reproduction in humans (sexual reproduction in human, fertilization, pregnancy and child birth)
objectives.teaching_methods: Question and answers, ICT based learning, Group discussion, Guest speaker
objectives.resources: Charts/ models of human reproductive system, charts/models/ pictures of meiosis stages, online resources of reproduction in human, and charts of family planning methods
objectives.assessment_criteria: Reproduction in humans is described clearly

objectives.text: (c) Describe the mechanisms of growth in mammals and flowering plants (concept of growth, mitosis and growth, growth and developmental stages in human and seed germination)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorm, ICT based learning, Group discussion, Project
objectives.resources: Photographs/ charts on growth in flowering plants, growth in plants online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: The mechanisms of growth in flowering plants and mammals are described clearly

objectives.text: (d) Explore the basic tenets of genetics (genetic materials, principles of inhertance, monohybrid, Mendelian and non-Mendelian inheritance; variation
objectives.resources: Charts/models photographs on basic tenets of genetics and online resources on basic tenets of genetics
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of genetics are explored clearly

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic skills for conducting biological investigations
competences: (a) Carry out investigation related to reproduction in flowering plants (flower structure and embryo)
(b) Investigate growth in flowering plants (hypogeal and epigeal germination)

objectives.text: (a) Carry out investigation related to reproduction in flowering plants (flower structure and embryo)
objectives.resources: Hibiscus flowers, razor blade, forceps, reproduction in plants online resources
objectives.assessment_criteria: Investigation related to reproduction in flowering plants performed correctly

objectives.text: (b) Investigate growth in flowering plants (hypogeal and epigeal germination)
objectives.resources: Seeds, pots, water, soil and charts/pictures on growth in plants
objectives.assessment_criteria: Growth in flowering plants is investigated correctly

sub_topics.title: Carry out a biological project work using biological principles
competences: (a) Complete and submit a report for the research project started in Form Three

objectives.text: (a) Complete and submit a report for the research project started in Form Three
objectives.resources: Relevant text on biology research project and online resources on research projects
objectives.assessment_criteria: Research project report are completed and timely submitted
